name: land_brake
_comment: U9 wave 4: landing speed gate by braking. Kit Crawler Slowbrake (inertialess, Speed 100 = 44 px/s, Accel 60, so Down takes about 4 s to stop it) requests landing at Kit Port, flies out 10 s, brakes 5 s, turns 180 deg, flies back 8 s (to well inside Kit Port's range), then holds Down while pressing `l` every ~160 ms: the first press that lands gives the speed gate (planet_track.mjs `v`). Pilot w4_brake_150.
